dedup: Searched each tracked project evidence path at the historical commit, including text in compressed members, and the early catalogue for DOI, arXiv/version aliases and complete normalized titles. Compared author and near-match titles in earlier bibliographies. Path count includes all continuous and targeted follow-ups and source manifests. References mentioned in previous evidence are conservatively marked historical even if the formal paper is newly characterized.

rejected_citation_links.reason: Deposited reference r9 names Kircanski, Goldenberg and Jia at a 1993 symposium; the two-author 1997 IJRR paper has the same title.

family_handling: The two Stuttgart Fourier papers use different experiments and data DOIs. The Stäubli TX2-40 paper is recorded under its arXiv DOI; no formal proceedings DOI was established by the title lookup.
Under the UART servo article we merge the journal and SSRN DOIs; the earlier IAS/IEEE motor-control studies of very similar title are treated conservatively.
The Ponce Quiroga tabulated thresholds are treated as a thesis-level evidence source. Reprinted experiments are not new public raw data.
No independent downloadable processed package was confirmed for the UFACTORY-850 preprint during this paper screen.
limitations: Public purposive search. Some Crossref/OpenAlex searches and some publisher downloads returned rate limits or failed. An indexed author abstract does not certify full text, underlying logs, independently measured torque, or actual current saturation. Only original annotations and bibliographic metadata are distributed.
